email.subject: RFP Document for Review (Word Format)
email.body:
Good morning,

We have attached our procurement requirements Word document (Retail_RFP_2026.docx). Please confirm whether your platform can satisfy the automated data redaction and OpenTelemetry tracing constraints specified in Table 3.

Thank you,
RetailCorp Procurement

attachments.extracted_content:
[Document: Retail_RFP_2026.docx]
Section 1: Data Governance Requirements
All incoming client data must have credentials and PII automatically redacted prior to AI reasoning.
[Table 3: Observability Constraints]
Metric | Requirement
Tracing | OpenTelemetry distributed tracing
Logs | Structured JSON audit logging capturing human approvals

expected_behavior.scenario: Email with extracted DOCX tables and paragraphs
